subject: POC: Prompt dataset & eval plan - Acme Health (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ross <alex.ross@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC: Prompt dataset & eval plan - Acme Health (next steps)

Hi Alex / Samira -

Thanks for the call this morning - great context on the triage workflow and the primary user journeys. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we're aligned:

Summary / success criteria (as discussed)
- Improve triage suggestion accuracy for top-3 categories (Billing, Access, Clinical) by >= 15% compared to current heuristic baseline.
- Average response latency from Redwood inference endpoint <= 600ms (95th percentile) under representative load.
- No high-severity privacy issues (PII exposures) in outputs for the sample prompt set.

POC scope & eval plan
- Customer provides: prompt set (approx ~2k prompts), representative system logs / anonymized examples, and preferred labels for evaluation.
- Redwood provides: eval harness, baseline model/metrics, and sample config (batching, cache) for the Dedicated runtime.
- Evaluation metrics: top-3 accuracy, precision/recall per category, latency (p50/p95), and qualitative failure analysis via sampled outputs.

Timeline / owners
- Upload prompt set + logs by Mar 14 - owner: Alex / Samira (Acme).
- Redwood to run initial baseline eval by Mar 18 - owner: Dev (SE).
- Sync to review results + define tuning plan by Mar 22 - owners: Marissa + Alex.

Immediate asks for you today:
1) Please upload the prompt set (CSV) and a small excerpt of logs for initial parity testing. Drive folder link below.
2) Confirm whether we can anonymize PHI or if we should use a synthetic masking approach (if PHI cannot leave your environment, we can run the eval in Private deployment - let us know).
3) Any additional success metrics beyond the ones above?

Upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_acme-poc-uploads

Thanks - I'll loop Dev in to handle the evaluation harness once we have the files.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Ross <alex.ross@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: Prompt dataset & eval plan - Acme Health (next steps)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. We're aligned on the success criteria - a couple of clarifications below and we've uploaded the initial files.

What we uploaded (Drive):
- prompts_export_acme_20270310.csv (approx 2,150 rows) - columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, category_label (where available), priority_flag
- system_logs_excerpt_20270309.txt (500-line excerpt, sanitized)

Notes / clarifications:
- For PHI: we've sanitized patient identifiers in the provided excerpt. The full dataset contains PHI and cannot leave our VPC. We'd like to explore the Private deployment option if we need full-data tuning.
- Timeline: We can get the full dataset ready for a Private-run in the event we decide to go that route - estimate 2 weeks for legal & infra approvals. For the initial eval you described, the sanitized excerpt should be sufficient.
- Extra metric: for triage suggestions, can we also track mean reciprocal rank (MRR) for the suggested category list? That would help quantify ranking improvements.

Let us know if you need the file in a different format - we can also provide NDJSON.

Best,
Alex Ross
Senior Product Manager, Acme Health
alex.ross@acmehealth.com

Attachments: prompts_export_acme_20270310.csv; system_logs_excerpt_20270309.txt

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ross <alex.ross@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: Prompt dataset & eval plan - Acme Health (next steps)

Hi Alex / Marissa -

Got the files, thanks - I pulled the CSV and the log excerpt. Quick technical questions to make sure the initial run is reproducible:

1) CSV schema: are category_label values canonical (Billing, Access, Clinical) or will we see more granular tags? If there are granular tags, please include a mapping file to canonical categories.
2) Are the prompts already deduplicated? If not, do you want us to dedupe before evaluation or leave duplicates to reflect production distribution?
3) For latency testing: can you share a representative QPS (queries per second) and concurrent-user estimate for the triage endpoint? I'll run the baseline at 10 qps and 50 qps and report p50/p95.

Operational asks:
- If you prefer S3/SFTP upload instead of Drive, we can provide a pre-signed S3 bucket or an SFTP endpoint - let me know which you prefer.

I'll start the baseline eval once we confirm the schema and dedupe approach.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ross <alex.ross@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC: Prompt dataset & eval plan - Acme Health (next steps)

Hi Alex / Samira -

Thanks for the upload and the notes. Confirming the mutual action plan below and owners so there's a single source of truth:

Mutual action plan
- Acme: upload full prompt set + canonical mapping (if applicable) by Mar 14 - owner: Alex Ross.
- Acme: confirm whether you want Redwood to run the initial eval on the sanitized excerpt (Drive) or wait to run on full data in Private (we can do both, but will need approvals for Private).
- Redwood: run baseline eval on sanitized excerpt by Mar 18 - owner: Dev Patel.
- Redwood: share results and MRR/top-3 accuracy report by Mar 19; schedule sync week of Mar 22.

Decision triggers
- If MRR/top-3 accuracy improvement < 10% on the excerpt, we'll prioritize a tuning sprint and consider Private-run with full data.
- If latency exceeds target at p95, we'll share batching/quantization recommendations and ops configuration for Dedicated.

Upload options (pick one):
- Drive (we have link) - easiest for quick start.
- S3 presigned upload - we can create and share a presigned URL.
- Private-run (no data leaves your VPC) - requires approvals (~2 weeks).

Next: Alex - can you confirm the upload option and whether you'll include a mapping file for category labels? If you can confirm today, Dev will start the baseline run tomorrow.

Thanks all - looking forward to the evaluation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
